title: Why Your Dreams Are So Bizarre and Confusing
hook: Ever woken from a dream feeling completely bewildered?

narration.text: Your brain doesn't create dreams in the way you might think.
During REM sleep, your brainstem sends random electrical signals.
The forebrain then tries to make sense of these signals.
It weaves a story, trying to interpret the random input.
This is called the Activation-Synthesis theory of dreaming.
It explains why dreams often feel so fragmented and strange.
Your brain is just trying to find a narrative in chaos.
Does understanding this change how you view your dreams?

description: Ever wonder why your dreams feel so disconnected and weird? It's not just random. The Activation-Synthesis theory suggests your brain is trying to make sense of random signals during sleep, creating the bizarre stories we experience.
topic: Why your dreams often feel fragmented and strange, explaining the Activation Synthesis theory of dreaming.
